units.title: Section 1: Listening and Appraising: Music History and Theory
generalObjectives: develop an appreciation for selected musical style periods throughout history;
understand the stylistic elements of performance synonymous with a cross-section of selected musical style periods studied;

develop an appreciation for the historical, economic and socio-cultural contexts and background within which music was originated, created and performed in a wide cross -section of musical style periods; and,
have a general perspective on the lives and works of notable composers, songwriters and performers in the cross-section of musical style periods studied.

units.title: Section 2: Listening and Appraising: Music Literacy and
generalObjectives: develop an appreciation for the elements of music for listening and appraising;
develop the knowledge and skills required to engage in music as an educative activity, valuing the process as much as the end product;
acquire direct experience of music through listening and appraising;
develop knowledge and understanding of the socio-cultural context of different types of music;
develop an appreciation for the use of technology to explore musical genres;
develop an appreciation for the variety and quality of sound produced from available technologies;
develop interpersonal, critical thinking, problem-solving and research skills by engaging in musical activities; and,
develop an understanding of the careers that utilise listening and appraising skills.

specificObjectives.title: describe the ways in which musical elements are used to create music of different genres;
describe the ways in which musical elements are used to create music of different styles;
evaluate music perceived;
evaluate the use of musical elements across genres;
evaluate the use of musical elements across styles;
describe ways in which expressive elements are used in performance;
describe ways in which timbral effects are used in performance;
specificObjectives.content: 8. appraise musical composition and performance practice in social and historical contexts;

specificObjectives.title: analyse and interpret a score to enhance the ability to listen and appraise; and,
discuss the value of listening and appraising skills in select careers.

units.title: Section 3: Performing
generalObjectives: develop an appreciation for the elements of music in performing;
develop the knowledge and skills required to engage in music performance and valuing the process as much as the end product;
develop an acceptance of diverse musical expressions and interests;
develop a musical understanding of aesthetic intentions of different styles and genres;
develop an approach to accurately perform what was intended by the composer or arranger;
develop the ability to interact with each other in a courteous exchange of ideas through the use of musical terms and idioms;
develop interpersonal, critical thinking, technological, problem-solving and research skills by engaging in different musical activities and performances;
develop an understanding and approach for performing in different environments; and,
develop an understanding of the careers that utilise performing skills.

specificObjectives.title: use expressive elements of a musical score when performing;
interpret expressive elements of a musical score when performing;
use structural elements of a musical score when performing;
interpret structural elements of a musical score when performing;
interpret musical styles when performing;
evaluate the structure of pieces performed;
demonstrate structural awareness in a performance;

units.title: Section 4: Composing
generalObjectives: develop an appreciation for the elements of music in creating a musical piece;
develop the knowledge and skills required to engage in music creation (composition and arranging), valuing the process as much as the end product;
appreciate the importance of independent learning through the development of analytical, communicative, manipulative, aural and translative (notational) skills;
develop the ability to identify short-term and long-term musical goals and to work with discipline and confidence towards the achievement of excellence;
develop interpersonal, critical thinking, technological, problem-solving and research skills by engaging in musical activities; and,
develop an understanding of the careers that utilize composing skills.

specificObjectives.title: manipulate a variety of sounds and sound sources in an original composition;
manipulate a variety of sounds and sound sources in an arrangement;
manipulate the elements of music appropriately in creating an original composition;

specificObjectives.title: outline musical goals in the composing process;
interpret stimuli to generate ideas for compositions and arrangements;
interpret musical elements to achieve varied aesthetic outcomes;
use compositional devices found in music of different genres;
